> **[Real Estate API](https://realestateapi.com) Integration Client for

![Real Estate API Logo](reference/figures/reapi-logo-color.svg)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Overview

`reapi` is a production-grade, robust R package that provides a
comprehensive API client library to interface and integrate with [Real
Estate API](https://realestateapi.com). Built on `httr2`, it offers
composable request construction & handling, intelligent caching, and
automatic response tidying for seamless integration into real estate
analytics workflows.

## Installation

Install from GitHub via:

``` r

pak::pak("jimbrig/reapi")
```

## Resources

See [LINKS.md](http://docs.jimbrig.com/reapi/LINKS.md) for an exhaustive
list of Real Estate API related resources and URLs.
